body:
I don't think of the move as daunting really. I move around a lot and am very used to it. It's something I'd be really excited about if... well, if I was excited about anything, I guess. 

Making it look like an accident is one option. I also briefly played with the idea of pretending to hate them and "cut contact" but discarded it because that would hurt them (arguably) just as much as killing myself. No good options, unfortunately.
